interactiveLearningBanner.body: Interactive guides walk you through Grafana one step at a time. "Show me" highlights the control to use, and "Do it" performs the step for you.
interactiveLearningBanner.title: Learn by doing

tour.cardBody: Open one and it runs right here, a step at a time. Your progress is saved if you close the panel partway through.
tour.doItBody: Clicks, navigation, and filling in forms all work this way, so you can watch what happens rather than hunt for it.
tour.finishBody: Steps can be repeated, and most can be skipped if they do not apply to you, so go at your own pace. Pick a guide whenever you are ready — the one you just opened is still in its own tab.
tour.handoffBody: Two buttons do all the work, and they are easier to show than to describe. Open a short guide and we will point them out.
tour.handoffTitle: Best seen in a real guide
tour.myLearningBody: My learning holds every guide you have finished, the badges you have earned, and any learning paths published privately for your organization — including ones not suggested for this page.
tour.myLearningTitle: Where the rest of it lives
tour.panelBody: This panel stays open beside Grafana while you work, so you practise in the real interface with your own data.
tour.privateBody: Guides your organization has published privately appear here, in among the public ones.
tour.progressBody: Your badges and streak sit up here, so you can see how far you have got without leaving the page.
tour.recommendationsBody: These guides are picked for the page you are on, so the list changes as you move around Grafana.
tour.showMeBody: It outlines the exact control the step is talking about and scrolls it into view. Nothing in Grafana changes, so you can look before you act.
